how_verified: The text of every document below was read from the copy kept in the repository folder knowledge_sources/, each of which is a scan or print of the Gazette of India. The gazette identifier was read from the document itself. These copies were NOT compared with the online official copies: the government sites (indiacode.nic.in, meity.gov.in, pib.gov.in) returned HTTP 403 to an automated download on this date. A named person should compare the fingerprints against a copy downloaded from the official site before the registry is approved.

documents.title: Notification G.S.R. 843(E): dates on which the Act's provisions come into force

effect.on_publication_2025-11-13: section 1(2), section 2, sections 18 to 26, 35, 38 to 43, and sub-sections (1) and (3) of section 44
effect.after_one_year_2026-11-13: sub-section (9) of section 6 and clause (d) of sub-section (1) of section 27
effect.after_eighteen_months_2027-05-13: sections 3 to 5, sub-sections (1) to (8) and (10) of section 6, sections 7 to 10, 11 to 17, section 27 except clause (d) of sub-section (1), sections 28 to 34, 36, 37 and sub-section (2) of section 44

documents.title: Rule 1 of the Rules: when the Rules come into force
documents.text_read: Rules 1, 2 and 17 to 21 on publication; Rule 4 one year after publication; Rules 3, 5 to 16, 22 and 23 eighteen months after publication.

documents.title: Corrigenda G.S.R. 892(E) to the Rules (G.S.R. 846(E))
documents.effect: Wording corrections in the Rules (G.S.R. 846(E)). It does not amend G.S.R. 843(E); some web summaries say it does, and the document itself shows it does not.
